name: coding-feature-json-format
description: Feature: add --format json option to list command with structured output

turns.userMessage: Add a `--format json` option to the `list` command. When specified, the output should be a structured JSON object with metadata (command name, timestamp, item count, items array) instead of just the raw array.

mockResponses.input_json: {"path":"src/args.ts","old_str":"export interface CliConfig { command: string; args: string[]; verbose: boolean; }","new_str":"export interface CliConfig { command: string; args: string[]; verbose: boolean; format?: 'json' | 'text'; }"}

mockResponses.text: Added `--format json` support: (1) `CliConfig` now has optional `format?: 'json' | 'text'`, (2) `parseArgs` parses `--format json` from argv, (3) `list` command outputs structured JSON with metadata (command, timestamp, itemCount, items) when format=json.
